{{Quote|The security deflector shield will be deactivated when we have confirmation of your code transmission.|Jad Bean|<ref name="ROTJ Credits">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
'''Jad Bean''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Death Star Trooper/Legends|Death Star trooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served inside the [[Death Star command center|control room]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Inform the commander that Lord Vader's shuttle has arrived.''"<br />"''Sir.|Endicott and Bean|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
[[File:Endicott_oversees.png|thumb|left|250px|Endicott looking over Bean's shoulder as the latter confirms ''ST 321''{{'s}} code transmission]]
At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Bean became a Death Star trooper and earned the rank of Sergeant. He was stationed in the [[Death Star command center]], where he was in charge of lowering the [[Battle station/Legends|Battlestation's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] so ships could arrive. He was on duty during [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] arrival aboard the battlestation, in which one of Vader's [[ST 321/Legends|shuttle]] pilots, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yorr/Legends|Yorr]], contacted the control room and asked them to lower the deflector shield. Bean, noticing the shuttle had a class-one priority ranking, was initially unsure of how to proceed and called over [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Endicott/Legends|Endicott]], who immediately recognized the shuttle as Vader's.<ref name="Episode VI Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']]</ref> Bean confirmed the shuttle's code transmission and deactivated the shield, clearing the ship to proceed. When the shuttle docked, Endicott ordered Bean to inform the battlestation's commander, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]], about Vader's arrival aboard the station.<ref name="Episode VI" />

During the final stages of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Bean replaced [[Unidentified Death Star trooper|another trooper]] at a [[Command sector duty post|duty post]] containing the station's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] firing switch and revolution controls, as Jerjerrod commanded him to begin rotating the battlestation so it could fire upon Endor's moon, at the order of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Bean likely fled his post or was incapacitated by the Rebel ships when they began bombarding the Death Star, as Jerjerrod himself took control of the superlaser's firing switch when it was set to fire on the moon.<ref name="Episode VI Novel" />

==Equipment==
Jad Bean wore the standard [[Imperial Navy trooper uniform|uniform]] for [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jad Bean was played by [[Stuart Fox]],<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> whose role was uncredited in {{Film|VI}}.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Although he appeared in ''Return of the Jedi'', the character was not given an identity until the release of the ''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]'', where he was named after fan Jad Bean, who is the founder of the [https://www.facebook.com/StarWarsMicroMachines Star Wars Micromachines page] on Facebook.<ref name="Jad Bean by the real Jad Bean">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jadbean.com/sergeant-jad-bean-an-officially-named-character-in-return-of-the-jedi.html|text=Jad Bean by the real Jad Bean|archivedate=20131108211254}}</ref> The photo representing him in the manual, however, was from a deleted scene from ''Return of the Jedi''.
